brief: GS TMT spec sales wrap centred on AI/semis into Q3 earnings. ASML enters results with pricing power (reported 10% Korean spare-parts hike accepted by Samsung/SK Hynix from Jan 2027), supporting its services/parts business (~25% of 2025 revenue, growing to more than 30% in 2026); TSMC should beat and raise Q4 guidance but the debate is whether management gives 2027 capex visibility (GIR already raised 2027E/2028E capex to $85bn/$98bn). Rising memory costs (CXMT's 4F2 DRAM push adding competition) are forcing Samsung to cut Q4 smartphone output 20-30% and Apple to shift iPhone 18 Pro orders toward Pro Max. Nvidia is in early talks to acquire or expand into Reflection AI, driven by Jensen Huang's frustration at hyperscalers building custom ASICs away from Nvidia GPUs/CUDA, and to counter DeepSeek; Amazon is separately in talks for Decart AI after Anthropic passed on it. Prosus cut FY27/28 EPS 7%/9% on higher food-delivery investment, weaker Tencent forecasts and higher refinancing interest costs, though JET MAU growth is accelerating. US data-center capacity forecasts rise for 2026 but fall for 2027 on ERCOT political constraints.
